Class WSEvaluateReplyResult

java.lang.Object
io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.protocol.WSEvaluateReplyResult
public class WSEvaluateReplyResult extends Object
Result for an individual transaction in a batch. Mutable: handlers populate fields on the instance the runtime hands them.
